Name: Toggle Monsters
Author: Rocketraccoon2004
Description:
Works Everywhere in the Game (I think)

May or May not be compatible with mods that add new locations (Stardew Expanded, Ridgeside Valley etc)

Note: this might take a few seconds to remove monsters after the toggle button is pressed

Configuration:
ToggleKey (default tilde) - the key used to toggle monsters (see https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/windows/xna/bb197781(v%3dxnagamestudio.40))

Downloads.Description: Fixed bug where SMAPI would always say the mod was not up to date
